bar.pause: Pause %1 and switch to Omarchy bar
bar.chooseReplacement: Choose a replacement for the built-in bar
bar.chooseReplacementHelp: Click Play on a replacement bar to switch to it.
bar.noReplacement: Install a replacement bar to switch away from the built-in bar.
plugin.noDescription: No description provided by this plugin.
plugin.upstreamAuthorShallow: Upstream earliest available commit %2 · Author: %1 (shallow history)
plugin.pauseManagerHelp: Pausing OmaPlugCtl closes this menu. To bring it back, run: omarchy plugin enable %1
updates.omarchyHelp: This built-in plugin is updated with Omarchy.
updates.dirtyHelp: Click to choose how to handle local changes before updating.
updates.chooseEdits: %1 has local changes. Stash them to keep them in Git, or discard them before updating.
updates.confirmDiscard: Permanently discard the reviewed local edits and untracked files in %1?
updates.divergedHelp: Installed commits are not all reproduced upstream. No changes will be overwritten.
sort.label: Sort by
sort.name: Name
updates.updateHelp: Click to update the running plugin checkout from its Git upstream.
updates.rewrittenHelp: Click to update. The previous version will be saved on a backup branch.
install.search: Search plugins or paste a link…
install.help: Install adds current upstream code, disabled. Verification covers the listed snapshot; enable separately when ready.
install.empty: No matching plugins. Try another search or turn off Verified only.
install.footer: Search the catalog or paste a GitHub, X, Marketplace, short, or supported project link. Hover loads GitHub commit details.
install.failed: Could not complete the action. Try Refresh.
config.title: Plugin manager settings
config.updateHelp: Click an update icon to update the running plugin in the background. Local edits are preserved. Equivalent upstream history rewrites are reconciled after saving a backup.
config.scanHelp: Scans the exact update locally, without uploads. Signatures refresh automatically. A threat or incomplete scan stops the update. A clean scan is not a guarantee of safety.
config.workspaceHelp: Requires My Workspaces or another compatible workspace widget. Additional existing workspaces remain visible.
config.workspaceUnsupported: Enable My Workspaces in Plugins to use this control. Stock Workspaces does not support a minimum button count.
runtime.required: PHP 8.1 or newer is required to use this plugin.
runtime.installHelp: Opens a terminal to install PHP from the Arch repositories. Enter your administrator password there if asked. This menu retries when installation finishes.
runtime.launchFailed: Could not open the installer. Run omarchy pkg add php in a terminal, then click Check again.
install.evaluating: Retrieving source, validating the manifest and scanning locally…
install.urlHelp: Evaluate retrieves GitHub code and checks the manifest and complete commit with local ClamAV. Install uses that commit, disabled. Public X posts and linked/quoted posts are searched; replies may be unavailable. No plugin code is executed during evaluation.
install.urlEmpty: Click Evaluate URL or press Enter to retrieve and validate this source.
install.author: Author: %1
about.feature.favorites: Star plugins and find them with the Favorites filter, even after disabling or uninstalling them. Reinstall from a saved repository, then enable when ready.
about.feature.manage: Enable, disable, move, and uninstall installed plugins.
about.feature.find: Search and filter installed plugins. Hover a row to locate its visible bar icon.
about.feature.install: Search the Omarchy marketplace or evaluate a repository URL before installing.
about.feature.updates: Check and install available updates with optional local ClamAV scanning.
about.feature.bar: Switch full bars and adjust bar position, icon size, and supported workspace controls.
kinds.updatesHelp: Show only plugins with a pending update.
kinds.favoritesHelp: Show starred plugins, including ones you uninstalled.
kinds.empty: No plugins match the selected filters.
plugins.noSearchMatches: No installed plugins match your search.
kind.bar-widget.label: Bar widget
kind.bar-widget.help: An item on the bar. Can be placed in a bar section.
kind.bar.label: Full bar
kind.bar.help: Provides an entire bar rather than one widget.
kind.overlay.label: Overlay
kind.overlay.help: Opens a visual interface, such as Machine Mark.
kind.panel.label: Panel
kind.panel.help: Provides an interactive panel opened on demand.
kind.menu.label: Menu
kind.service.label: Service
kind.service.help: Runs background functionality; may also supply other kinds.
kind.other.label: Other
kind.other.help: The listing has an unspecified or unrecognized kind. Evaluate a repository to inspect its manifest.
